_comment: Overrides for tools/bake_arch_mesh.py. Everything here is optional; the baker only needs it when filenames are ambiguous or the scan is mirrored.
_teeth: Map a filename to a Palmer designation (LL1-LL8, LR1-LR8) when the name does not contain exactly one. Universal and FDI numbers are accepted here too and translated. Use null to skip a file -- that is what the combined-arch STL wants.
_flip_z: Set true only if --report says the numbering-derived basis is LEFT-HANDED, which means the scan is a mirrored export.
_scale: Scan-units-to-world scale. Leave null to normalise the arch to the extent the view is tuned for; set it only to pin a bake against an earlier one.
